### The Longing of the Thirsty - Truth For Life - November 6
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-6-2019.html
Passage: Isaiah 44:3
Points:
- Believers in a low spiritual state often try to escape it through self-chastisement, which only deepens their despair.
- Gospel liberty and Christ's love—not legalistic guilt—restore a fainting soul and draw the backslider back.
- When you feel barren or useless in God's service, Scripture promises an abundant outpouring of divine grace.
- Just as water revives dormant plant life, God's refreshing grace satisfies your heart and makes you fruitful once more.

### The Blessing
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-dec-27.html
Passage: Isaiah 44:3
Points:
- God promises to pour out His Spirit and blessings upon our descendants and offspring.
- Many children spend years yearning for tangible proof of their parents' heartfelt love and approval.
- Taking time to pray aloud and specifically bless a child imparts deep spiritual confidence.
- Parents should create an intentional, regular practice of communicating God's blessing over every part of their children's lives.
